clusters.label: Power generation
clusters.definition: Production of electrical power.
clusters.reason: Both denote the same general application; demonstrated functionality and proposed potential remain separate claims.

clusters.label: Strong lattice anharmonicity
clusters.definition: Pronounced departure of lattice vibrations from harmonic behavior.
clusters.reason: All identify the same lattice property. Materials, structural causes, calculation conditions and transport consequences qualify the individual claims.

clusters.label: Metallic behavior with increasing temperature
clusters.definition: Metallic transport behavior identified through its temperature dependence.
clusters.reason: The evidence describes temperature-dependent physical behavior rather than a calculated electronic-structure classification.

clusters.label: Metallic behavior from electronic structure
clusters.definition: Metallic electronic character identified from calculated band structure or density of states.
clusters.reason: All identify electronic metallicity through electronic-structure analysis, including zero gap or states at the Fermi level.

clusters.label: Metallic behavior of selenides
clusters.definition: Metallic character attributed to the ACrSe2 selenides.
clusters.reason: The metallic classification is explicit, but the supplied evidence does not establish its equivalence to temperature-dependent transport or calculated electronic metallicity.

clusters.label: Transport properties in c-axis electrical transport
clusters.definition: Electrical transport properties implicated by c-axis resistivity in the graphite intercalation compound.
clusters.reason: The resistivity evidence supplies a specific electrical and directional context.

unresolved.reason: Grain and boundary effects do not specify which transport properties are meant.
The annealing and segregation context does not identify the affected transport quantities.
The broad computational scope does not resolve which transport properties the label includes.
The secondary-phase effect leaves the transport mode and quantities unspecified.
Band-dispersion differences suggest an electronic context but do not define the transport-property set.

clusters.label: Unit-cell expansion
clusters.definition: Increase in the dimensions or volume of a crystallographic unit cell relative to a reference.
clusters.reason: Both denote the same structural change. Different compositions, reference phases and causes remain attached to their claims.

clusters.label: Refractive index
clusters.definition: Optical quantity characterizing light refraction and propagation in a material.
clusters.reason: All explicitly identify the same optical quantity; spectral dependence, material identity and trends are claim conditions.

clusters.label: Lattice contraction
clusters.definition: Decrease in crystallographic lattice dimensions.
clusters.reason: All denote the same structural contraction, with distinct dopants, causes and transport effects retained in the claims.

clusters.label: Coordination bonds
clusters.definition: Bonds formed through coordination interactions within the polymer network.
clusters.reason: Both labels denote the general coordination-bond interaction in hierarchical networks; neither names a chemically specific bond subtype.

clusters.label: Half-metallic character
clusters.definition: Electronic character combining metallic behavior in one spin channel with a gap in the other.
clusters.reason: All explicitly report calculated half-metallic electronic character. Compounds, functionals, gaps and spin-polarization results qualify individual claims.

clusters.label: Positive phonon frequencies
clusters.definition: Phonon frequencies having positive values.
clusters.reason: Both denote the same sign-qualified vibrational quantity, separately from the stability conclusions drawn from it.

clusters.label: High thermal stability of calorimeter operation
clusters.definition: Stability of thermal measurement conditions during slow heating and cooling.
clusters.reason: The evidence concerns instrument operation enabled by thermoelectric sensing and heat pumping.

clusters.label: High thermal stability of ionic liquid analogs
clusters.definition: Resistance of the ionic liquid analogs to thermally induced change over the tested temperature interval.
clusters.reason: The evidence concerns material stability assessed by thermogravimetry, distinct from calorimeter operating stability.

clusters.label: Semiconducting character
clusters.definition: Electronic character of a semiconductor, with a band gap separating valence and conduction states.
clusters.reason: All explicitly denote semiconductor character rather than a particular gap value, measurement or prediction method. Gap types, compositions and computational conditions remain claim attributes; the Sr2MoSbO6 relations explicitly support this label despite its paper title.

clusters.label: Tetragonal structure
clusters.definition: Crystal structure belonging to the tetragonal crystal system.
clusters.reason: Both labels genuinely denote the crystal-system class, without asserting identical compounds or detailed structures.

clusters.label: Impurity phases
clusters.definition: Additional material phases distinct from the intended host phase.
clusters.reason: Both denote the general phase category without specifying chemical identities. Formation versus negated introduction belongs to the claims.

clusters.label: CuAgSe
clusters.definition: The ternary compound with composition CuAgSe.
clusters.reason: Both explicitly identify CuAgSe without conflicting compositional qualifiers; synthesis, density and transport results remain sample claims.

clusters.label: Phase purity
clusters.definition: Degree to which a material contains the intended phase without secondary phases.
clusters.reason: All concern the same phase-composition property. The differing XRD and microscopy findings for Cu1.8S remain attached to that claim without correction.

clusters.label: Enhanced power factor
clusters.definition: Increase in thermoelectric power factor relative to a comparison or baseline.
clusters.reason: All denote improvement of power factor, rather than its absolute value or the mechanism producing the improvement. Baselines and enhancement magnitudes remain claim-specific.

clusters.label: Ductile behavior
clusters.definition: Mechanical tendency to undergo plastic deformation before fracture.
clusters.reason: All denote ductility inferred from mechanical analysis. Materials, elastic criteria and proposed bonding explanations qualify the claims rather than define different ductility concepts.
